item.title: Race Industry Week interview: WEC CEO Frederic Lequien
item.description: Speaking during EPARTRADE’s Race Industry Week, Frederic Lequien, CEO of the FIA World Endurance Championship (WEC), offered a wide-ranging look at the series’ explosive growth, technical philosophy, and long-term roadmap as it heads into what he called an “amazing” next chapter.

item.title: Formula E drivers want a longer Miami track
item.description: Miami E-Prix winner Mitch Evans described the layout of the Miami International Autodrome used for the first time in Formula E over the weekend as “a challenge” and admitted he would have liked a longer lap.

item.title: Eriksson, Envision team encouraged by progress in Miami
item.description: Already on a high from his best qualifying result to date, Joel Eriksson remained with the breakaway lead pack to eventually bring home his Envision Racing car fourth.

item.title: Clash postponed again, until midweek
item.description: The Cook Out Clash at North Carolina's Bowman Gray Stadium has been postponed by a few more days, with NASCAR now aiming for Wednesday, Feb. 4.

item.title: Kirkwood and Power like what they see at Miami Formula E
item.description: Andretti Global NTT IndyCar Series drivers Will Power and Kyle Kirkwood came away impressed from their trip to the Miami E-Prix and eager to give the electric race cars a go.

item.title: 'Get your s**t together' - Wolff claps back on questions of PU legality
item.description: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff has told rival power unit manufacturers to “get your s**t together” and focus on their own performance rather than questioning the legality of the Mercedes design.

item.title: Russell sees F1 top four being closely matched based on early 2026 running
item.description: George Russell says the top four teams of Mercedes, McLaren, Red Bull and Ferrari all look closely matched from the initial running of 2026 Formula 1 cars in Barcelona, while he also is not discounting Aston Martin’s potential.

item.title: ‘Little Dave’ Malukas ready to make a big move at Penske
item.description: Veteran teammates Newgarden and McLaughlin have his back, and Team Penske's newest IndyCar driver feels ready to fill some big shoes.

item.title: Andretti Global reveals new livery for Power’s No. 26
item.description: Andretti Global has released images of Will Power’s No. 26 Honda and its new livery for 2026.

item.title: Fingers in the air about the NASCAR year ahead
item.description: There is a lot of intrigue about what’s to come in 2026, from a return to Chicagoland to additional horsepower and the re-introduction of the Chase format. Kelly Crandall makes some educated guesses about what's in store.
